$doc: Beautify-10x modifier matrix — per-surface aesthetic state the loop reads/writes every fire. Protocol: create → beautify 10x in a row → on every revisit, if beautifyPasses < 10 or aiVisionScore < 9.5, queue more passes. Modifiers stack: gorgeous, cinematic, kinetic-type, glass+grain, bento, WebGL, motion-choreo, a11y-delight, density(coinbase-pro), speed.
$scale: aiVisionScore 0-10 (visual-qa rubric); beautifyPasses = completed 'make it more gorgeous' iterations; density 0-10 (0=marketing-airy, 10=coinbase-pro-cockpit)
